opening_quotes: We're open from 8.30am Monday to Saturday for sightseeing.
Our Dome Galleries open at 9.30am with last entry at 4.15pm.
Opening and closing times can change, so we recommend you visit our calendar to check the day you will be attending.
fee_quotes: It's free to worship at St Paul's, but sightseeing is ticketed. The cost of our Monday to Saturday sightseeing is £27 per adult and £10.50 per child
accessibility_quotes: measures in place to improve physical accessibility

opening_quotes: On occasions there will be activities that preclude casual visits and mean the church is closed at short notice
pages.notes: The page also carries dated closure notices from earlier years; they are not treated as current.

accessibility_quotes: There is step-free access to the church from both Piccadilly and Jermyn St.
The main body of the church is step-free with a wide central aisle.

opening_quotes: All are welcome to our chapel services that are held in the Wren Chapel every Sunday.
pages.notes: No casual visiting hours on this page; chapel access outside services is via the Royal Hospital's tours and events.
